about.short: I make videos, designs and websites. I started with a camera at age 10 and have been building creative skills ever since.
about.long: I started with videography at age 10 to 11 and taught myself everything after that, mostly through YouTube: video editing, graphic design, filmmaking, photography and 3D animation. I worked for more than two years as a self-employed video editor. Today I also build full websites as a MERN stack developer, and I bring a designer's eye to how they look and move.
